name: Sneh Adhikari
heroTitle: Hi, I'm Sneh — a network engineer in Kathmandu.
heroLede: I work on firewalls, WAFs, DDoS protection and enterprise routing for government and commercial infrastructure. Currently at NextGen Solutions.
about: I'm a network engineer based in Kathmandu. Most of my work happens on-site — rack builds, patch panels, and firewalls running under real production load.
I started out with a cybersecurity internship and a stint in IT support, and I still do the vulnerability testing and documentation I picked up there.
Outside of work I'm studying computer science further, and I automate the boring parts of the job whenever I can.
skillsSub: Grouped by what I actually use them for.
projSub: Short descriptions — the details belong in a conversation.
contactMessage: If you have a project, need a hand with firewalls or network infrastructure, or just want to talk — drop me a message.
